title: The Alibi of Windrow House
author: Mirabel Reyes
blurb: Sable Winterbourne, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
